verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only AI-agent-driven, site-wide edits: switching the site from light to dark mode, applying new brand colors, and changing typography across the site. That approximates applying a theme across designs, but nothing shows a managed token or variable system with modes. Missing for 10: documented color, spacing and typography variables or styles, theme or mode definitions that can be switched, token management UI or docs, and independent hands-on corroboration.
